subject: Manager transfer & interim coverage for Backend Platform team
messages:
From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 20 Nov 2025 15:12:00 -0800
Subject: Manager transfer & interim coverage for Backend Platform team

Hi Dev —

Following our 1:1 today, I wanted to formally start the transfer process for Priya Natarajan from my org (Platform Integrations) into Michael Grant's Backend Platform team. Priya has been a critical IC for the past 18 months and expressed interest in moving under a manager more focused on platform services to support her growth toward tech lead.

Proposed timeline:
- Nov 28: Announcement to Priya and affected stakeholders
- Dec 1: Official manager change in HR systems (effective date Dec 8)
- Dec 8–Jan 12: Michael to be listed as manager; I will provide interim coverage for project continuations through Dec 31 to avoid disruption during the holidays.

I know there are approval steps for manager changes and a short handover doc + manager_transfer_form to complete. Monica, can you confirm what HR approvals and paperwork we need and whether we should route this through Legal for employment terms?

Action items:
- Dev: Confirm capacity for Michael to take Priya on Dec 8 and that team bandwidth is ok for onboarding tasks.
- Monica: Confirm approvals needed and DocuSign flow.
- Laura: Please hold a 30-minute slot for the announcement draft and a short sync for managers.

Attaching a draft team org (team_structure_v2.xlsx) and the blank manager_transfer_form.pdf.

Thanks —
Evelyn
Evelyn Hart
Director, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference

From: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 21 Nov 2025 09:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Manager transfer & interim coverage for Backend Platform team

Evelyn —

Thanks for the summary. Michael confirmed with me this morning that he has the capacity to bring Priya on starting Dec 8 and is excited about the match. A couple of quick notes:

- Michael requests a 1-week shadowing period prior to full ownership (Dec 8–Dec 15) to transfer context on the data ingestion work.
- We should keep Priya on the Integrations sprint board through Dec 31 for two outstanding tickets so nothing spills over.

Monica, anything else we need from Eng payroll or managers to trigger the transfer? Also: is there any change to Priya's manager-level compensation or is this strictly a reporting line change?

Thanks —
Dev
VP, Engineering Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 08:21:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Manager transfer & interim coverage for Backend Platform team

Evelyn / Dev —

Thanks for the heads up. HR checklist and next steps below:

1) Manager transfer form (signed by current manager, new manager, and People Ops) — attached as manager_transfer_form.pdf.
2) Compensation change?
   - HR records show Priya's base and target comp are unchanged; no comp regrade required. If there were a level change we'd route to Compensation Committee.
3) DocuSign flow: I will initiate the DocuSign to Priya + Michael + Evelyn after you confirm dates. Link will be the docusign url in related_links.
4) Systems work: People Ops will update Workday and Slack manager field effective Dec 8. If you need to backdate the change for payroll reasons, request by Dec 1.
5) Legal: No new terms needed for a lateral move. I asked Ava Jones (external employment counsel) to stand by in case redlines are requested.

Next steps: please reply with confirmed effective date (Dec 8 if agreed) and whether we want the 1-week shadow as formal part of the transition plan.

— Monica
Monica Patel
People Operations Partner
Redwood Inference
Attachment: manager_transfer_form.pdf

From: Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael_grant@redwood.com>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Tom Reed <tom.reed@acme-analytics.com>
Date: Mon, 24 Nov 2025 09:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Manager transfer & interim coverage for Backend Platform team

Team —

Confirming the plan: Dec 8 effective date, with Dec 8–Dec 15 designated as shadowing/knowledge transfer. Evelyn will continue as interim owner for outstanding Integrations tickets through Dec 31 and will copy Michael on all status updates. Monica will send the DocuSign packet this afternoon.

Laura: please draft the announcement (short: who/what/why/next steps) — target send Nov 28.

Tom (cc'd) — I'm looping you from the integrations side so ACME Analytics sees the manager change for the ongoing contract work; no change to billing or contacts.

Thanks everyone —
Evelyn
Director, Platform Integrations
Redwood Inference
